# APE

> APE documentation


## ape-mvp-docs

How to get access, what every part of the workspace does, and how to ship what you build.

- [APE documentation](/index.md): How to get access, what every part of the workspace does, and how to ship what you build.

### search

- [Search the documentation](/search.md)

### APE

- [How your work is saved](/APE/concepts/how-your-work-is-saved.md): Every prompt is a commit. Nothing reaches master without a pull request.
- [Sessions](/APE/concepts/sessions.md): A container, a branch, and an agent – and what happens when you walk away.
- [Templates and projects](/APE/concepts/templates-and-projects.md): Sandbox scaffolds, real Vinted repos, and the ones you make yourself.
- [Getting access](/APE/getting-started/getting-access.md): Two clicks and one command. About a minute, once.
- [Introduction](/APE/getting-started/introduction.md): What APE is, who it's for, and where it's going.
- [Quick start](/APE/getting-started/quick-start.md): From nothing to a working prototype in five minutes.
- [CLI SSH onboarding](/APE/reference/cli-and-ssh-onboarding.md): For engineers who want to work on a session in Cursor over SSH.
- [Reference](/APE/reference/reference.md): Statuses, limits, costs, and every aiw command.
- [Troubleshooting](/APE/reference/troubleshooting.md): What to do when it doesn't work.
- [Publishing](/APE/shipping/publishing.md): A public URL for a prototype, and keeping it current.
- [Pull requests](/APE/shipping/pull-requests.md): From a branch to something reviewable.
- [Files and history](/APE/the-workspace/files-and-history.md): Seeing what changed, editing it yourself, and going back.
- [Pointing at things](/APE/the-workspace/pointing-at-things.md): Clicking a thing instead of describing it.
- [Prompting the agent](/APE/the-workspace/prompting-the-agent.md): What to say, how big asks get planned, and the three things Enter can do.
- [The live preview](/APE/the-workspace/the-live-preview.md): The real app, running, with a URL bar.
- [The session screen](/APE/the-workspace/the-session-screen.md): A tour of the two panes, the header, and everything behind Advanced.
- [Comments and notes](/APE/working-with-others/comments-and-notes.md): Feedback attached to a thing, and messages meant for a person.
- [Sharing](/APE/working-with-others/sharing.md): Who can see your prototype, and who can change it.
